name: Foldseek
compares: Predicted 3-D shapes. Each residue of an AlphaFold model gets one of 20 shape letters (3Di) from its local fold. The shape letters are aligned together with the amino acids.
reference: AlphaFold models of the relative's proteome (Quest for Orthologs reference proteomes, release 2020_04 accessions), as a Foldseek database.
score: Bit score: higher ranks first. The E-value cutoff was 10.
caveats: A protein with no AlphaFold model cannot be searched. Five relatives have no Foldseek rows at all (chimpanzee, cow, dog, opossum, western clawed frog): not run.

AlphaFold models of long proteins come in overlapping pieces (F1, F2, ...). The task script moves piece n's coordinates 200 x (n - 1) residues along the protein; if a piece started elsewhere, its calls would land in the wrong place. Checked against the real piece starts: not measured.

known_failure_modes.finding: In the ELM motif run, Foldseek was scored on orthologs that have no AlphaFold model. It cannot search those, so its share of motifs found is low for a reason that is not the search.
known_failure_modes.number_note: The source does not count the orthologs with no AlphaFold model.

evidence.quote: Foldseek and Reseek were scored on orthologs with no AlphaFold model too, so their shares are low for a reason that is not the search

known_failure_modes.what_to_do: Score a structure tool only on proteins that have a structure, and print how many proteins were left out.

known_failure_modes.finding: Aligner calls run past the domain, because a call spans the whole aligned stretch. Over correct calls, they start a median 5 to 21 residues early. Over all calls, 45% to 60% start more than 100 residues early.
known_failure_modes.number: median 5 to 21 residues early; 45% to 60% more than 100 residues early

evidence.quote: Over correct calls, the median of call start minus true start is 0 for hmmscan, whose models define the Pfam truth, so the 1-based reading of truth and aligners holds. Aligners start a median 5 to 21 residues early, because a call spans the whole aligned stretch.
45% to 60% of aligner calls start more than 100 residues early, not "most"

known_failure_modes.run: `make leaderboard-pileup` and the region pile-up page (Figure 4)
known_failure_modes.what_to_do: Read a call's ends as the alignment's ends, not the domain's. To score where a domain sits, place the target's domain through the alignment.

commercial_use: Yes. If you distribute a changed version, you must release its source under GPL-3.0 too.
command:
foldseek search \
    human-38fdd87d_fsdb/db zebrafish_fsdb/db result foldseek_tmp \
    --threads 16 \
    -e 10.0 \
    --max-seqs 1000
questions: Is the closest same-family domain in the relative you will search at least 40% identical, for most of your proteins? If yes, Fmax here is 40–60% 0.164 (n = 563), 60–100% 0.241 (n = 1,289). If no, 20–30% 0.268 (n = 93), 30–40% 0.167 (n = 165). (Pfam truth set, raw calls, zebrafish (430 Mya) as the relative searched, setting shape letters + amino acids; subsets with at least 30 true instances.)
Do you have a 3D structure prediction for every protein you want to annotate? If not, Foldseek cannot search the proteins without one.
Can you spend about 0.129 core-hours per 1,000 proteins for each relative you search? That is the measured mean per relative; see "Cost per 1,000 queries" below.
